ارتجعتا (form VIII)
# اِرْتَجَعَتَا (irtajaʕatā) /ir.ta.d͡ʒa.ʕa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِرْتَجَعَ (irtajaʕa)
# اُرْتُجِعَتَا (urtujiʕatā) /ur.tu.d͡ʒi.ʕa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِرْتَجَعَ (irtajaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
